component.name: Astra Weather
component.summary: Live weather from your Tempest station

description.p: Astra Weather integrates with WeatherFlow Tempest Weather Stations to provide real-time weather data, lightning detection, and comprehensive forecasts directly in your COSMIC Desktop panel.

ul.li: Real-time updates - live weather data every few seconds
Lightning, high-wind, and rain alerts with desktop notifications
Multi-day forecasts - 7-day hourly and 10-day daily forecasts
Multiple station support - manage and switch between Tempest stations
Available in English, German, Spanish, Scottish Gaelic, and Japanese
Configurable units for temperature, wind speed, pressure, precipitation, distance, and time
Station health monitoring with color-coded connection status
Secure API key storage in the system keyring
Color weather icons with day and night variants

description.p: Note: This applet requires a WeatherFlow Tempest Weather Station and API key to function.

screenshot.caption: 7-day hourly forecast with color weather icons and automatic day/night variants
Real-time weather conditions from your Tempest station
Station health monitoring with connection status
Desktop notifications for lightning strikes, rain events, and high winds
Compact panel display with temperature, weather icon, and wind direction
Comprehensive unit preferences with multiple options per unit type

description.p: Initial release of Astra Weather for COSMIC Desktop

ul.li: Real-time updates from Tempest Weather Stations
Lightning detection with desktop notifications and visual alerts
7-day hourly and 10-day daily forecasts with color icons
Multiple station support with health monitoring
Five languages: English, German, Spanish, Scottish Gaelic, and Japanese
Secure API key storage in the system keyring
